groups.name: Record fibres
groups.domain: All 2-valued record and target maps on three worlds; independent enumeration of all two-input decoders.

groups.name: Behavior and initialization
groups.domain: Every one-action system through three states, every binary readout and record; refinement compared with direct histories through n^2 steps.

groups.name: Composition and hidden return
groups.domain: All ordered pairs of 2x2 matrices with entries -1,0,1; fixed first-coordinate split; independent scalar defect identity.

groups.name: Operation-word transport
groups.domain: All two-action systems on two source and two target states, every translation, and every word of length at most five.

groups.name: Propagated discrepancy quotient
groups.domain: All one-action pairs of 2x2 F2 matrices and scalar readouts; closure compared with powers through four and mixed words through four.

groups.name: Correction-signature dynamics
groups.domain: All 256 subsets and 16 partition-union events of the eight-world sensor; each equal-signature class checked under every event.

groups.name: Partition-memory count
groups.domain: Every partition through four worlds, every binary target, every candidate subset, and exactly the partition-union event family.

groups.name: Bayesian report sufficiency
groups.domain: All binary likelihood and reporting channels on the half grid; five priors, including both degenerate priors; impossible columns and ancillary flag controls.

groups.name: Common posterior-risk bounds
groups.domain: All two-world priors on the quarter grid; response pairs in {0,1/2,1}; two bounded Lipschitz losses; direct risk and gap checks.

groups.name: Fixed-recipient intersections
groups.domain: All three-case binary sender maps and two-artifact acceptance tables; compared with direct enumeration of every sender encoder.

groups.name: Explicit-tree Pareto feasibility
groups.domain: All one-experiment binary state/report tables on two states, two terminal success tables, nonempty supports and horizons 0..2; direct full-tree profiles vs pruned recurrence, plus four-origin tradeoff.

groups.name: Depth and full stored-tree bounds
groups.domain: All binary tree profiles through eight leaves, plus unary padding and explicit balanced/equality procedures for n=1..16.

groups.name: Finite grammar refinement
groups.domain: Every grammar of length 1..3 over all binary truth vectors on three contexts, every target; earliest solution and teacher-call count.

groups.name: Exact preservation of proposed syntax and evidence
groups.domain: All length-four ordered grammars on two Boolean contexts, with repeated semantic functions treated as different source AST identities; every target.

groups.name: Capacity and identical ordered streaming search
groups.domain: Capacities 1..4 and all legal prefixes; literal report completions; all two-query libraries through four cases with singleton repairs and horizons 0..2.

groups.name: Dependency-complete invalidation
groups.domain: Every forward DAG through four nodes and all directly changed subsets; topological propagation compared with independent reachability closure.

groups.name: Resource-price dependence
groups.domain: All three-coordinate difference vectors on -2..2 and price grid {0,1/2,1}; rational convex mixtures; recheck source weighted-search values.

groups.name: Adaptive conditional false-acceptance budgets
groups.domain: Six-stage finite probability trees with history-dependent hazards at or below declared budgets; exact total event probability, not sampling.

groups.name: Joint target reconstruction
groups.domain: All 2x2 F2 record matrices and scalar target maps; kernel condition compared with direct enumeration of linear decoders.

groups.name: Enabled-set quotient
groups.domain: All partial one-action transitions on two states, binary labels, both partitions; direct enumeration of every quotient label and partial transition.

groups.name: Continuation and authorized ending
groups.domain: Every run/end action catalogue on two observed states with nonempty successor sets drawn from {0},{1},{0,1}; fixed target {1}; fixed-point results compared with all stationary policies.
